name: Abstract IP Geolocation
tagline: Locate any IP address with city, country, and ISP data via AbstractAPI.
description: AbstractAPI IP Geolocation returns location and network metadata for an IP address, including city, region, country, coordinates, timezone, and ISP. Developers call a simple REST endpoint with an API key to enrich logs, personalize content, or flag risk by geography.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter; self-serve signup at AbstractAPI.

use_cases: get city and country for a visitor IP
enrich server logs with ISP and location
block or flag traffic by country code
